        print("Article not found.")
        return
    
    # Assume the first result is the article page
    article_url = search_result[0]['url']
    
    # Navigate to the article page
    await page.goto(article_url, wait_until='load')
    
    # Extract all images from the article page
    images_data = await extract_images_from_page_manual(page, article_url)
    
    # Return the images data as-is without processing
